template.event: if element("materialId"):GetInt() > 0 then game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgMaterialInformationRequest(element:GetReceiver(), element("materialId"):GetInt()) ) element:DoStoredScript("enableMe") else element:DoStoredScript("disableMe") end

--[[print ("setMaterialAmtPossessed: Possessed "..element("numPossessed"):GetInt()) print ("setMaterialAmtPossessed: Needed "..element("numNeeded"):GetInt())]] if element("numPossessed"):GetInt() ~= -1 and element("numNeeded"):GetInt()~=-1 then element:DoStoredScript("populate") end

--[[if both values needed have been set]] if element("numPossessed"):GetInt() ~= -1 and element("numNeeded"):GetInt()~=-1 then element:DoStoredScript("populate") --[[if store, only one value is needed]] elseif element("storeItem"):GetInt() == 1 and element("numNeeded"):GetInt()~=-1 then element:DoStoredScript("populate") end

local s = "" if element("repairMode"):GetInt()==1 and element("storeItem"):GetInt()==1 and element("numNeeded"):GetInt() >= 0 then s = "+" elseif element("repairMode"):GetInt()==1 and element("storeItem"):GetInt()==0 and element("numNeeded"):GetInt() >= 0 then s = "-" end
s = s..element("numNeeded"):GetInt() element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("text"):SetString(s)
--[[if not store, text is red if you don't have enough, else it's white]]
if element("storeItem"):GetInt() == 0 and element("numPossessed"):GetInt() < element("numNeeded"):GetInt() then element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("red"):SetFloat(1.0) element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("green"):SetFloat(0.0) element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("blue"):SetFloat(0.0) else element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("red"):SetFloat(1.0) element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("green"):SetFloat(1.0) element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("blue"):SetFloat(1.0) end
local height = element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("height"):GetInt() local width
if element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("width"):GetInt() > element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("width"):GetInt() then width = element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("width"):GetInt() else width = element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("width"):GetInt() end element:setSize(Vector2(width, height))
--[[element["Touch"]("width"):SetInt(element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("width"):GetInt()) element["Touch"]("height"):SetInt(element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("height"):GetInt()+element["MaterialReqs"]["Text"]("height"):GetInt()+(element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("height"):GetInt()/2))]]

local materialId = msg.materialId; if materialId == element("materialId"):GetInt() then
element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("spriteName"):SetString(msg.imageID .. "") element["ItemImage"]["Sprite"]("sheetName"):SetString("xml_resources/" .. msg.spriteSheetID) else --[[ignore this message]] end
